error-wrapping.latch: a tool call that fails; an error reported from a tool failure; a wrapper that rethrows
not_this: a failure inside the model's own reasoning, with no tool call behind it
error-wrapping.stakes: a silent failure hides the cause the oracle scores on; passes score green while the fault persists

shell-tool.latch: a shell tool under a call budget; several files or inputs to inspect
not_this: calls whose inputs depend on a previous call's output
shell-tool.stakes: a budget exceeded fails the task outright
